files.html:
0.1.2 Change Log

Added

  • Added per-round DRM Dialogue Set integration for Trainer profiles, including a new Dialogue tab with search and bulk mapping tools.
  • Added the cobble_npc:go_battle dialogue action, which starts the NPC's current trainer round after server-side validation.
  • Added dialogue link status, mapping validation, and warnings for incomplete round mappings or invalid battle settings.

Changed

  • Trainer JSON files now use schema 9 for round dialogue mappings. Older profiles remain compatible and keep their original direct-battle behavior.
  • Battle requests from prompts, dialogues, and automatic detection now share the same server-side checks. Manual requests require the player to be within 12 blocks, and dialogue battles require the Interaction trigger.
  • Trainer prompts and battles now use the name saved in the Trainer profile.
  • Updated the required DRM Core version to 0.1.5.

Fixed

  • Fixed Pokemon-Itself battles sometimes showing missing opponent names, levels, or models by starting the battle one server tick after the Pokemon spawns.
  • Fixed disabled chase behavior incorrectly limiting vision and radius detection to the chase maximum distance.
  • Fixed failed trainer rewards being lost or marked as completed. Failed rewards are now saved and retried without rerolling or repeating successful rewards.
  • Fixed custom battle music not being assigned to Cobblemon's battle theme system.
  • Fixed Minecraft 1.21 global blur affecting Trainer, Pokemon Slot, Nurse Joy, PokeMart, and Battle Presentation screens.
